title: shipping-and-delivery.md
content:
Shipping & Delivery Policy:
- Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days from ship date.
- If a package has not arrived within 7 days of the ETA, the customer is eligible for a replacement or refund.
- Always provide the tracking number when discussing order status.
- For orders marked 'out_for_delivery', reassure the customer it is expected within 24 hours.

title: refund-policy.md
content:
Refund Policy:
- Refunds are approved for orders that are damaged, defective, or significantly not as described.
- Refunds must be requested within 14 days of the delivery date.
- Always ask for the order ID and a brief reason before issuing a refund.
- Do not issue a refund for orders still in transit — advise the customer to wait for delivery first.

title: size-exchange.md
content:
Size & Exchange Policy:
- Customers may exchange an item for a different size within 30 days, subject to stock availability.
- Always check inventory before confirming an exchange is possible.
- If the requested size is out of stock, offer to notify the customer when it's back, or suggest a refund instead.
